youtube_description:
Entrepreneur in Residence Scott Shigeoka captures the journeys of Atlanta entrepreneurs, highlighting their triumphs and struggles as they make their own way. Brought to you by GoDaddy. Watch more Made in America videos: https://bit.ly/gdmadeinamerica   

You can’t tame the heart of an entrepreneur — especially one that’s been Made in America. They defy the odds by stepping over the gaps of racial disparities, financial barriers and cultural norms to make their mark as a small business owner. It’s the entrepreneur who knows in order to truly experience the American Dream, they must rise together with their community. They work day in and day out to build their business and inspire future generations to believe anything is possible. Because Black Futures Matter. Tune in with Scott Shigeoka as he follows along with the stories of Atlanta entrepreneurs who have built their business from the ground up, overcame challenges of a pandemic and continue to chase the American Dream.
